description: Open-source, clean-room download manager written from scratch in pure Rust with torrent support
notes: The portable build includes a 'data' folder beside misterdownloadmanager.exe, which switches on Mister Download Manager's portable mode: the download list, settings, IPC state and crash logs live there, and nothing is written to the registry. Scoop junctions that folder to '$persist_dir\data', so your data survives 'scoop update'.
If the MDM_DATA_DIR environment variable is set, Mister Download Manager uses that directory instead and this persist location is bypassed.
The first install copies an existing %APPDATA%\misterdownloadmanager into the persist folder, and the pre-uninstall hook mirrors it back as a safety copy; that also runs on 'scoop update'.
Browser integration (native messaging host registration) requires the official installer; the portable build does not write to the registry.
Use 'scoop update misterdownloadmanager' instead of the built-in updater so the install and this manifest stay in sync.
pre_install: abort 'Mister Download Manager is running, so %APPDATA%\misterdownloadmanager cannot be copied into Scoop persist safely. Quit it, then run the install again.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while copying '$legacy' to '$target'; compare the two directories before relying on the new location." } else { info "Copied '$legacy' to '$target'." }
pre_uninstall: warn 'Mister Download Manager is running, so the state was not mirrored back to %APPDATA%\misterdownloadmanager. Quit it and uninstall again if you want that safety copy.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while mirroring '$data' back to '$legacy'." } else { info "Mirrored '$data' back to '$legacy'." }
